# TODO

## Localize texts generated by code

Texts written by NetLogic code are plain strings, so they stay in English whatever the session language is.
They should become real `LocalizedText` values (TextId + translations in `ProjectFiles/translations.csv`).

- Fleet card and KPI texts: `ConnectedText`, `ConnectedRatioText`, `AlarmText`, `PowerText`, `DayText`, `CoverageText`, `UpdatedText` ("2 of 2 ovens online", "Process and connection alarms", ...).
- Oven details texts published under `manager/Details/*` (`ModeText`, `StateText`, `ConnectionText`, `PhaseText`, ...) and `LocalSimulation/LastResult`.
- Alarm messages ("{#DeviceID} is disconnected"). Keep them plain, with no formatter or converter on retained runtime alarm nodes (SessionHandler crash).
- Texts with values need a key with placeholders and the argument formatted separately.
- Changing the variable type from String to LocalizedText affects the bindings saved in Studio (Dialogs, Fleet): migrate them together.

## Dark theme leftovers

Fixed by `ApplySoftDarkPalette`, `FixThemeOverrides` and `ThemeAnalyticsChart` (run them in Studio, then save): palette, log rows fill, card alarm strip, status chip colors, input text color, OEE chart page per theme.

- Inactive navigation icons: `MenuElement` icon `DynamicColor` has a fixed `#3b3b3b` for the not selected state, almost invisible on dark. Needs a theme-aware color.
- DataGrid selected row (OEE grid): light blue fill with white text, low contrast.
- Switch, CheckBox and SpinBox default styles are light in the Dark stylesheet.
